_about: pilot.net's WORLD STATUS box (front page). Each key is a story flag name. label: the line's name. values: the text for each value of the flag, keyed by the value as text ('0', '1', 'true', 'false'...). default (optional, text): the value to use while the flag isn't set. requires (optional): StoryDirector conditions; the line shows only while they pass. The story script sets a value with StoryDirector.set_flag(name, value); a value with no text shows as it is. See database/pilotnet/README.md. These entries are samples.
